title: Calculate Tokens — Pricing Data
description: Schema for public/api/v1/prices.json. Single source of truth for model IDs, tokenizer mapping, pricing, and feature flags.

version.description: Semantic version of the prices.json schema in use

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this file was last generated

display_name.description: Human-readable model name shown in the UI

provider_pricing_url.description: HTTPS URL to the provider's official pricing page

tokenizer.description: Tokenizer implementation key. 'heuristic' = Math.ceil(chars/4), no Wasm worker spawned.

context_window.description: Maximum context window size in tokens

input_cost_per_1m.description: USD cost per 1 million input tokens

output_cost_per_1m.description: USD cost per 1 million output tokens

supports_context_caching.description: Whether the model supports prompt caching / context caching

oneOf.description: Fractional discount on cached input tokens (e.g. 0.9 = 90% cheaper)

supports_batch_api.description: Whether the provider offers a batch/async API with reduced pricing

oneOf.description: Fractional discount when using the batch API (e.g. 0.50 = 50% cheaper)

thinking_model.description: Whether this model exposes an extended thinking / chain-of-thought token budget

oneOf.description: Multiplier applied to the thinking token budget when estimating thinking token count

thinking_billed_separately.description: true = thinking tokens add to output cost (OpenAI o-series). false = thinking is bundled in output token price (DeepSeek R1).

requires_js_render.description: true = check-page-changes.js must use Playwright headless rendering instead of fetch (e.g. Anthropic pricing SPA)

last_checked.description: ISO 8601 timestamp — updated automatically by the pricing-check CI job

last_human_verified.description: ISO 8601 timestamp — updated only when a human has navigated to provider_pricing_url and confirmed values. Drives amber staleness indicators in the UI.

active.description: Whether this model is shown in the UI. Set to false to soft-delete without removing from the file.

pricing_note.description: Human-readable note about temporary or introductory pricing, displayed in the UI near cost figures.

pricing_note_expires.description: ISO 8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD) after which pricing_note should no longer be displayed.
